{{Top|leg}}
A '''timer mine''' was an explosive [[Mine/Legends|mine]] that was originally designed to be deployed by [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droids]] for use in [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. Activated by a [[timer]], the mines were altered for military use and was used by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TimerMineDark">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Timer Mine (Dark)}}</ref> and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TimerMineLight">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Timer Mine (Light)}}</ref> Specific models of timer mines included the [[3HX3 timer mine]] manufactured by [[Conner Ship Systems]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer/Legends|LIN demolitionmechs]] were designed to plant timer mines, taking them from a spinning internal rack and carefully laid them on the ground.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
